# pineconebyoc_amp_access (Resource)

The `pineconebyoc_amp_access` resource lets the environment's Prometheus write metrics to Pinecone's Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus (AMP).

Pinecone trusts `workload_role_arn` and returns `pinecone_role_arn`. Allow the workload role to assume it, as in the example.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pineconebyoc_amp_access" "this" {
  cpgw_api_key      = pineconebyoc_environment.this.cpgw_api_key
  workload_role_arn = aws_iam_role.amp_ingest.arn
}

# Lets the ingest role assume the role Pinecone returns.
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "assume_pinecone_role" {
  name = "amp-assume-pinecone-role"
  role = aws_iam_role.amp_ingest.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = "sts:AssumeRole"
      Resource = pineconebyoc_amp_access.this.pinecone_role_arn
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpgw_api_key` (String, Sensitive) The environment's `cpgw_api_key`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `workload_role_arn` (String) ARN of the environment's metrics ingest role. Updates in place.

### Read-Only

- `amp_region` (String) AMP region.
- `amp_remote_write_endpoint` (String) AMP remote-write endpoint.
- `id` (String) The workload role the access was granted to.
- `pinecone_role_arn` (String) The role in Pinecone's account the ingest role assumes.
